chunks: Muḥammad ibn Sahl narrated from his father, who said:
I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about one who bowed in ruku' with an Imam of a people who is followed, then raised his head before the Imam. He said: “He should repeat his bowing with him.”

key_terms.إِمَامِ: the prayer leader being followed in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.رَأْسَهُ: his head, meaning he lifted himself from bowing
key_terms.رَكَعَ: performed bowing in ruku' during salat (prayer)
key_terms.يُقْتَدَى: is followed as an Imam in prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he rises from ruku' before the Imam in congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning congregational salat (prayer). If a follower raises his head from ruku' before the Imam, he should return and perform the bowing again with the Imam, emphasizing proper conformity with the Imam in congregational prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1173 - Muhammad ibn Sahl narrated from his father who said:

“I asked Imam Al-Ridha (as) about a person who bows (in ruku') with an Imam of a congregation who is followed, and then raises his head before the Imam.”
Imam (as) replied: "He should repeat his bowing (ruku') with him."
